rationale: The plan loads tables, validates rendering provider join cardinality, then executes two complementary analyses: group_comparison aggregates volume, paid amounts, denial and fraud rates by specialty and network status jointly (addressing the requirement to compare across both dimensions); provider_ranking identifies the top 10 rendering providers by claim volume with their specialty and network status from the provider directory. Report parameters enforce statistical discipline (show_denominators, cite_artifacts) and data quality (min_group_size=30 for small-group flagging). Caveats acknowledge synthetic data, descriptive scope, and small-group limits.
